#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <iomanip>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    
    if (n >= 100) {
        cout << 0 << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    
    vector<int> a(n + 1), b(n + 1), c(n + 1), d(n + 1), e(n + 1);
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        cin >> a[i] >> b[i] >> c[i] >> d[i] >> e[i];
    }
    
    vector<bool> bad(n + 1, false);
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        bool is_bad = false;
        for (int j = 1; j <= n && !is_bad; j++) {
            if (i == j) continue;
            for (int k = 1; k <= n && !is_bad; k++) {
                if (j == k || k == i) continue;
                
                long long ax = a[j] - a[i];
                long long bx = b[j] - b[i];
                long long cx = c[j] - c[i];
                long long dx = d[j] - d[i];
                long long ex = e[j] - e[i];
                
                long long ay = a[k] - a[i];
                long long by = b[k] - b[i];
                long long cy = c[k] - c[i];
                long long dy = d[k] - d[i];
                long long ey = e[k] - e[i];
                
                double val = ax * ay + bx * by + cx * cy + dx * dy + ex * ey;
                long long m1 = ax * ax + bx * bx + cx * cx + dx * dx + ex * ex;
                long long m2 = ay * ay + by * by + cy * cy + dy * dy + ey * ey;
                
                val = val / sqrt((double)m1);
                val = val / sqrt((double)m2);
                
                double angle = acos(val) * 180.0 / M_PI;
                if (angle + 1e-9 < 90.0) {
                    bad[i] = true;
                    is_bad = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    int cnt = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (!bad[i]) cnt++;
    }
    
    cout << cnt << endl;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (!bad[i]) cout << i << endl;
    }
    
    return 0;
}
